candidate.answerReason: A zero-slope line has constant ordinate. It is the x-axis when that constant is zero and is parallel to it otherwise.

methods.label: Horizontal-line equation
methods.explanation: A line with slope 0 has equation \(y=b\). If \(b=0\), it coincides with the \(x\)-axis; otherwise it is parallel to the \(x\)-axis. Thus C is correct.
methods.levelReason: Uses elementary coordinate geometry and explicitly includes both horizontal-line cases.
